create_Dct2d_instance: create a Dct2d module with a custom blocksize for blockwise 2D discrete cosine transform
run_Dct2d_forward: run the Dct2d forward pass on a single channel tensor to compute blockwise DCT coefficients
run_Dct2d_inverse: run the Dct2d inverse method to reconstruct an image from DCT coefficients using iDCT
review_Dct2d_init: review the Dct2d constructor to understand blocksize and interleaving parameter configuration
test_Dct2d_roundtrip: test the Dct2d forward and inverse methods together to verify lossless reconstruction of input tensors
